{%- comment -%} OVERRIDES just-the-docs 0.12.0's `_includes/vendor/anchor_headings.html`, which `_layouts/default.html` calls on every page's content when `heading_anchors` is on. The theme's file is kept VERBATIM, renamed, as `vendor/anchor_headings_core.html`; this wrapper only decides what it sees. Included as the theme does, from its `_layouts/default.html`, with html=content. Takes every parameter the theme's include takes, and passes each through. Overwrites: _ahs_* (Jekyll's include `assign`s are page-global). WHAT CHANGED, AND WHY (owner's report, 2026-10-15). The theme's pass splits the WHOLE content on "..
it finds into a multi-line heading with an anchor link -- including text inside an inline " ("") after it -- where an HTML parser ends it too -- and is emitted untouched. Every other piece goes through the theme's pass as before. Content holding neither tag goes through the theme's pass whole, exactly as the theme does it. Limits, stated rather than hidden: tag names are matched in lower case (as every generator here writes them); a heading that itself CONTAINS a " raw, so headings there lose their anchors. Each degrades an anchor; none breaks a script. Each piece is EMITTED as it is cut, not appended to an accumulator (`capture out` of `{{ out }}{{ piece }}` copies all that came before, on every piece): the output is the same string, without the O(pieces x page) copying.
